messages:
maya shah: quick heads-up — onboarding titian-13b-lite. need a fast smoke plan for quantization (int8 vs fp8 vs gguf). goal: 2-4x cost reduction while keeping <=3% quality regression on our chat-eval set. any quick wins or blockers?

arjun patel: +1 on a smoke matrix. proposed minimal matrix:
1) gguf fp8 (fast path)
2) int8 per-channel w/ bias correction
3) fp16 baseline (perf + gold quality)
Keep batch=1 and streaming enabled for latency realism.

liam chen: calibration dataset callout: ~500 prompts sampled from core-chat (50% multi-turn, 30% docs, 20% code). include short and long comps. use seeds [42,7,99] to check variance across RNG.

sophia torres: quick automated gating checklist (smoke):
- perf: latency p95 <= 1.5x fp16
- quality: MRR drop <= 2 pts (absolute) or <= 3% relative
- safety: run 100 safety prompts; fail if any new toxicity flag
- embedding drift: cosine distance <= 0.03
Also add a human spot-check of 20 representative dialogues.

sophia torres: add adversarial stress cases (n=5) that historically regress under int8.

arjun patel: minimal config snippet to kickoff: 
```
quant_profile: int8_per_channel
calib_dataset_size: 500
calib_mode: layerwise_minmax + bias_corr
fallback: fp16_on_threshold(kl>0.02 or mrr_drop>2)
batching: dynamic(max_batch=8)
```

infra-bot: kicked off `quant-smoke/titian-13b-lite/2623456789` on pool `dedicated-rt-quad` — CI job 7821. logs will stream to /runs/7821.

bench-bot: preliminary smoke results (first pass):
- gguf-fp8: latency p95 110ms, cost ~0.45x baseline, MRR drop -1.8 pts (passes gate)
- int8-per-channel: latency p95 130ms, cost ~0.35x baseline, MRR drop -2.6 pts (fails quality gate)
- fp16 baseline: latency p95 95ms, MRR baseline
Note: safety run showed zero new toxicity hits in smoke set.

maya shah: takeaways — gguf-fp8 looks like a viable fastpath (meets quality gate). int8 needs more careful calibration (try larger calib set and bias correction tuning). Plan: roll fp8 fastpath for initial rollout and re-run int8 with 2k calibration and per-layer bias correction.

liam chen: I'll queue a 2k calib run with stochastic rounding off, deterministic seeds, and per-layer histogram collection.

sophia torres: ops notes: tag the model `fastpath:fp8-gguf-v1`, rollout to 20% of traffic, monitor MRR/latency traces and error rates for 24h. if MRR drift >1.5 pts or latency p95 >1.6x, auto-rollback.

maya shah: thanks — tagging @sre for rollout window and @sales to update cost estimates for the pricing sheet :chart_with_upwards_trend:
